findings.current: Jealous of Jin Taekyung, who received the attention of someone who seemed to care for him almost affectionately.
findings.defect: “Someone” obscures that the attention comes from the Blood Lord’s own master.
findings.rationale: 그런 주인 refers directly to the master whose disregard for his servants the Blood Lord resents.
findings.replacement: Jealous of Jin Taekyung, who had all but monopolized that same master’s almost affectionate attention.
findings.source: 그런 주인에게 애정에 가까운 관심을 한 몸에 받고 있는 진태경을.

findings.current:
“I don’t know. I just…”

“What?”

“I simply knew. Naturally.”
findings.defect: The pause is moved into the first answer, and “too” is lost.
findings.rationale: 나도 means “me too”; the hesitation belongs to his explanation after the Blood Lord asks again.
findings.replacement:
“I don’t know either.”

“What?”

“I just… knew, as if it were the most natural thing in the world.”

findings.current:
His body was shoved backward, unable to withstand the force.

Jin Taekyung fell, unable even to keep his body upright.
findings.defect: Immediately after the Blood Lord twists the spear, “his body” can be read as the Blood Lord’s rather than Jin Taekyung’s.
findings.rationale: The next sentence identifies Jin Taekyung as the one who falls.
findings.replacement:
Jin Taekyung was shoved backward, unable to withstand the force.

He fell, unable even to keep his body upright.
findings.source:
힘을 이기지 못하고 밀려 나가는 몸뚱어리.

신형조차 제대로 가누지 못한 채 쓰러진 진태경을 향해

summary: The draft largely preserves the fight, but obscures the Blood Lord’s reason for envying Jin Taekyung and introduces a few localized ambiguities.
